mapper.select: select count(*) from tbl_wish where expert_seq = #{expertSeq}

select p.expert_seq, m.name, p.profile_image, (select count(*) from tbl_review r where r.expert_seq = p.expert_seq) as review_count, (select round(avg(r.rating), 1) from tbl_review r where r.expert_seq = p.expert_seq) as average_rating, (select listagg(distinct c.name, ', ') within group (order by c.name) from tbl_talent t inner join tbl_category c on c.category_seq = t.category_seq where t.expert_seq = p.expert_seq and t.enabled = 'Y') as category_names, (select count(*) from tbl_wish w2 where w2.expert_seq = p.expert_seq) as wish_count from tbl_wish w inner join tbl_expert_profile p on p.expert_seq = w.expert_seq inner join tbl_member m on m.member_seq = p.expert_seq where w.member_seq = #{memberSeq} and p.hidden = 'N' and m.enabled = 'Y' order by w.regdate desc
